character.name: Delphine
character.title: The Ice Starlet
character.motto: Shine under your own spotlight and make every entrance unforgettable.
character.micro_lore: Stepping onto the frosted red carpet at dusk, Delphine sparkles under flashbulbs, spreading warm cheer and champagne wishes across the winter gala. Her signature champagne-boba in hand, she invites guests into an evening of high-fashion holiday enchantment.

prompts.prompt_front_artwork: High-fashion glamour portrait of Delphine, The Ice Starlet, standing elegantly on a frosted velvet red carpet at dusk outside a snow-dusted luxury palace gala. Holding a crystal stemmed glass filled with sparkling champagne-boba pearls with a rose gold bow. Wearing an haute couture crystalline ice-blue and obsidian silk evening gown embroidered with micro-sequins and 4-point gold starburst filigree. Warm paparazzi camera flashbulbs glowing in background, cinematic depth of field, 8k resolution, photorealistic, elegant rim lighting.
prompts.prompt_back_design: Collector trading card back layout, deep obsidian midnight background #0A0E1A, sharp rectangular rose gold border #B76E79 with 1.5pt vector stroke. Four-point gold starburst filigrees in each corner. Central shimmering gold star target with ⟡ TAP HERE ⟡ NFC symbol. Elegant typography in Playfair Display and Montserrat.
prompts.prompt_motion_video: 9:16 vertical video. Slow push-in on Delphine on the winter gala red carpet at night. Flashbulbs popping in soft bokeh. She gently tilts her crystal champagne-boba flute toward camera, winks with sparkling ice-blue eyeshadow, and smiles warmly as snow crystals drift gently through golden light. High frame rate, cinematic lighting, luxury party atmosphere.
prompts.prompt_voice_dialogue: Vocal style: Playful, elegant, warm transatlantic starlet tone. 'Champagne in hand, glitz on full display! Delphine here to invite you to the most glamorous party of the season—Happy Holidays!'
prompts.prompt_negative: blurry, low resolution, cartoon, distorted fingers, extra limbs, bad anatomy, muddy colors, oversaturated neon, flat lighting
